candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (load, saturation, network) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from inventory and ReadTimeout through order to 502 at gateway checkout. Metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
